info.name: Valor Admin Portal Stage 3A - LOCAL DEVELOPMENT ONLY
info.description: Local-development API verification only, NOT browser/UI verification. Only http://localhost:8081 is permitted. Run all 15 requests in Collection Runner, one iteration, sequentially. Requires existing active customer/building/lift chain and technician. Directories/list pages repeat automatically. Customer/building selection may advance to another live eligible candidate to find a complete chain. The unique retained request ends ACCEPTED; no deletion, report writing or technician-only endpoint is used. Stop on failures, inspect assertion names, repair prerequisites, then restart at 01; never resume after failure. Set credentials only as private local environment values; do not export populated environments or save response examples. Postman itself can retain sensitive network data; do not share run exports or console captures. Negative coverage: a token-free GET /me asserts 401; role-based 403 is not exercised because this collection uses only SUPER_ADMIN and does not provision additional identities.
